Name: FS Silver's hairdressing
Author: SilverTinyFox
Description:
The cute hair from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33553?tab=description]other mod[/url] for Fashion Sense!﻿ With a few extra customization options + hairstyles (only loose and bun for now).
Make sure to download Fashion Sense or you won't be able to use them!

Don't know which pack to download? see LS TS comparison image on the mod's media to see the difference!
